description: threshold=NaN made the monitor silently never alarm; threshold<=0 alarmed at the first monitored step. The false-alarm bound m/threshold is meaningless for such values.
reproduction: pytest tests/test_audit_agent1.py -k rejects_nonpositive_or_nan_threshold (failed before the fix, 3 cases)
evidence: Probe before fix: threshold=nan -> 0 events in 300 N(0,1) returns; threshold=0 or -5 -> 5 events (one per recalibration). SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Fixed: ValueError unless threshold > 0. inf is still allowed.

description: cal_len 0 or 1 was accepted; the baseline was then built from a single return (scale = 1.48|r|). cal_len=1 gave 3 false alarms in 100 N(0,1) returns.
evidence: Probe: cal_len=1 -> 3 events, cal_len=0 -> 1 event on 100 N(0,1) returns. SYNTHETIC.

description: m0 = 0, negative or NaN silently returned 'no alarm' (m0=0 also produced divide-by-zero warnings), so a mis-calibrated caller gets a dead detector.
reproduction: pytest -k rejects_invalid_null_mean (3 cases, failed before fix)
evidence: Probe: m0=0, -1, NaN -> alarm [-1] with no error. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Fixed: ValueError unless m0 is positive and finite (arrays of per-row m0 still accepted).

description: A negative entry in x was accepted although the e-process is only nonnegative for x >= 0 (a negative x can make a bet factor negative). Also an unknown kind was only rejected when the series was non-empty.
evidence: Probe: x[50] = -5 accepted, statistic path continued. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Fixed: ValueError for any x < 0; kind validated up front.

description: Series shorter than the window crashed with 'argmax of an empty sequence'.
recommended_action: Fixed: returns alarm -1 when n < window.

description: c = NaN or inf was accepted; with NaN the monitor never calibrated and never alarmed, silently.
reproduction: pytest -k rejects_invalid_truncation_constant (nan and inf cases failed before fix)
evidence: Probe: c=nan -> 0 events, calibrated False. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Fixed: ValueError unless c is finite and positive.

description: The two benchmark detectors do not skip missing values: one NaN return freezes the statistic at NaN and no alarm can follow (the main detector and the monitor do skip NaN since review m17). Simulated callers (E4, E11) pass no NaN; whether any real-data benchmark row (E13 etc.) passes NaN was not traced.
evidence: Probe: clean alarm at 101 (Gaussian LR) and 104 (Page CUSUM); with one NaN at t=5 both return -1. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Not fixed because a fix could change published benchmark numbers on real data. Ask the author whether E13 real-data rows contain NaN returns; if so, drop NaN before calling or add the skip rule and rerun E13 and trace_numbers.

description: With init=None (default) and strict=False the start value is the median of the first 50 returns, so entries 0 to 49 use data at and after their own time (start-up look-ahead). Already documented in the docstring and flagged by the earlier review. Used by experiments/e03_online_truncation.py with defaults.
evidence: Entry 0 changes when returns 40 to 49 change (init=None); it does not with init given or strict=True. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Document in any claim that uses E3 online truncation; pass init from earlier data when strict predictability matters.

description: The frozen-feed rule looks at the whole run of zero returns, so deciding that the first minutes of a run are NaN uses later minutes. Documented as a cleaning step for historical data, not for live use.
reproduction: pytest -k mark_frozen_run_length_boundary (checks the boundary: run of min_run is blanked, min_run-1 kept)
recommended_action: State in the real-data write-up that the frozen-feed cleaning is retrospective.

description: Library defaults call numpy default_rng() without a seed in simulate.py (3 places) and design.py (2 places), and guard.rank_seed=None. Every experiment and test passes an explicit rng or seed; the two unseeded default_rng() calls in experiments/e20_inference.py are immediately overwritten with a saved state. The rank fallback of the guard is nondeterministic only if guard_fallback='rank' and no rank_seed is given (not the default).
reproduction: grep -rn 'default_rng()' src experiments scripts; replay tests in test_audit_agent1.py
evidence: Replay with the same seed is bit-identical; another seed differs. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: None needed; mention when explaining reproducibility.

description: The number tracer accepts coincidental matches: a number is traced if the same value appears anywhere in a source in scope, so the README's '570 tests' is traced to an unrelated alarm count in E25. This lets a stale count pass. Not tightened: a safe fix needs per-claim source declarations, which is more than a small change.
reproduction: python scripts/trace_numbers.py --target README.md --out <scratch>; row for 570 shows source docs/report_parts/E25.md
evidence: Reported by the coordinator and visible in the committed results/trace/readme_trace.csv (line 5, value 570, source E25.md). Not re-derived by me.
recommended_action: Add a declared-source registry for test counts and other headline integers, or flag integers whose only match is in a different experiment than the sentence.
